crossRefs.note: A false balance is an abomination to Yahweh, but accurate weights are his delight.
Differing weights and differing measures, both of them alike are an abomination to Yahweh.
Yahweh detests differing weights, and dishonest scales are not pleasing.
“ ‘You shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in measures of length, of weight, or of quantity.
You shall have just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin. I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of…
You shall not have in your bag diverse weights, one heavy and one light.
“You shall have just balances, a just ephah, and a just bath.
A merchant has dishonest scales in his hand. He loves to defraud.
Saying, ‘When will the new moon be gone, that we may sell grain? And the Sabbath, that we may market wheat, making the…
Shall I be pure with dishonest scales, and with a bag of deceitful weights?

translations.web: Honest balances and scales are Yahweh’s; all the weights in the bag are his work.
translations.bsb: Honest scales and balances are from the LORD; all the weights in the bag are His concern.
translations.kjv: A just weight and balance are the LORD'S: all the weights of the bag are his work.
translations.asv: A just balance and scales are Jehovah's; All the weights of the bag are his work.
